# requires: transfer
#
# A checkpoint claiming forty proven bytes, and a partial file that does not
# exist. The resume point is the SMALLER of the two, always — trusting the
# record alone produces a file of the right length and the wrong bytes, and
# that failure is invisible until somebody hashes it.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
claim A alpha 5000
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
state A

# expect 5: ok state=transferred [DL-R1]
# expect 5: done=64 err=none
